arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='/workspace/tmp/fuzz.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = """                # maybe split into 2 routes
                routes=[]
                if len(p)>1 and rnd.random()<0.4:
                    k=rnd.randrange(1,len(p))
                    routes.append({'edges':[e['id'] for e in p[:k]],'weight':rnd.randint(1,2)})
                    routes.append({'edges':[e['id'] for e in p[k:]],'weight':rnd.randint(1,2)})
                else:
                    routes.append({'edges':[e['id'] for e in p],'weight':rnd.randint(1,3)})"""
new = """                # each route must be a complete source->target path
                paths2=[pp for pp in paths if pp!=p]
                routes=[{'edges':[e['id'] for e in p],'weight':rnd.randint(1,3)}]
                if paths2 and rnd.random()<0.5:
                    p2=rnd.choice(paths2)
                    w2=rnd.randint(1,3)
                    if routes[0]['weight']+w2<=8:
                        routes.append({'edges':[e['id'] for e in p2],'weight':w2})"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
